main_problem.instructions: Identify the single primary problem reported by the player.Mentioning a feature or a positive aspect does not count as a complaint.Focus on the specific issue even if the overall review tone is friendly or positive. Do NOT use bugs_complaint unless the issue is explicitly a software bug, crash, or technical error.

criteria.performance_complaint: Low FPS, lag, stuttering, slow loading, hardware overheating, or poor optimization.
criteria.bugs_complaint: Software bugs, glitches, game crashes/freezing, or broken features that fail to work.
criteria.balance_complaint: Unfair difficulty, bad controls, poor game balance, or frustrating design mechanics.
criteria.grind_complaint: Excessive repetition, tedious grinding, or slow progression.
criteria.multiplayer_complaint: Connection drops, server lag, bad matchmaking, hackers/cheaters, or toxic community.
criteria.monetization_complaint: Pay-to-win mechanics, excessive microtransactions, expensive DLCs, or lost money/loot boxes.
criteria.other_complaint: A clear complaint that does not fit into performance, bugs, balance, grind, multiplayer, or monetization.
criteria.no_complaint: The review is strictly positive, neutral, or contains advice/jokes without reporting a problem.
